net_change_vs_prior.note: No new CRITICALs. 5 new HIGHs: /ask paywall bypass (free users get free Gemini calls), jwt.verify algorithm confusion in lumora-within-ascend, token revocation gap in lumora authenticate, CORS Railway substring match, lifetime plan missing from PERSONAL_HOUR_BUDGETS.

findings.description: verifyToken() does not enforce payload.type === 'access' — add type check so refresh/other tokens are rejected by all middleware
createToken() accepts any payload without type claim validation — add type allowlist in createToken()
requireAdmin() checks role === 'admin' but role field is never set (always 'user') — change to check is_admin boolean
Cookie domain hardcoded to '.cariara.com' with no env override — add COOKIE_DOMAIN env support for staging
Bearer token parsed with slice(7) not split(' ')[1] — standardize parsing across all middlewares
OWNER_EMAILS auto-applies is_admin at every startup — manage admin grant via DB, not env auto-grant
Both OWNER_EMAILS and ADMIN_EMAILS supported with no deprecation path — standardize on one variable
Refresh endpoint uses ignoreExpiration without max-age check — add 90-day max-age limit on token age
ADMIN_SECRET endpoint has no rate limiting — add IP-based lockout or exponential backoff
CORS allows origins containing 'ascend' or 'camora' keyword substring — switch to explicit allowlist
ADMIN_EMAILS check is case-sensitive — normalize with .toLowerCase() and use Set.has()
OAuth state freshness uses Date.now() — replace with server-TTL cache to avoid clock skew rejections
shared-auth verifyToken has no algorithm whitelist — add algorithm: ['HS256'] to jwt.verify options
Referral code truncates base64url output — keep all 8 chars from randomBytes(6) for full entropy
Token issuance at /me does not check is_active flag — add account suspension check
verifyToken calls jwt.verify with no algorithms option; three other copies patched to HS256 but this lumora-within-ascend copy was not — add { algorithms: ['HS256'] }

authenticate middleware does not check users.token_generation; POST /auth/revoke-all-sessions revokes ascend jwtAuth routes but all lumora routes accept the revoked JWT until 30-day natural expiry — check token_generation on every authenticate call
CORS Railway check uses origin.includes('capra-backend') && origin.endsWith('.railway.app') — substring match; evil-capra-backend.railway.app passes both conditions; switch to exact-origin allowlist
Referral-code backfill migration uses SUBSTR(MD5(RANDOM()::TEXT || id::TEXT), 1, 8); PostgreSQL RANDOM() is not a CSPRNG — use encode(gen_random_bytes(6), 'hex') for future migrations

GET /me in lumora-backend unconditionally mints a fresh 24h access_token on every call with no near-expiry guard; ascend-backend gates re-issuance to within 7 days of expiry — apply the same guard here
JWT_ALGORITHM is env-configurable; setting it to RS256 enables algorithm-confusion attacks — hardcode to HS256 like the canonical shared-auth modules
OwnerRoute calls isOwnerEmail(user?.email) instead of isOwner(user) which also checks user?.is_admin — DB-granted admins are locked out of all /admin/* frontend routes despite working backend access
GET /api/visitors/pageview-stats (admin-only) missing apiLimiter; adjacent /api/visitors/visitors-detail has it — add apiLimiter for consistency
Team price formula (n*20-1)*100 contradicts billing.js tiered formula — reconcile to single authoritative calculation
Tiered team price formula ($49+$10/seat) contradicts teamService.js — customers charged inconsistently by code path
Hardcoded plan type check missing 'lifetime' — import PAID_PLAN_TYPES from @camora/shared-db/plans
PAID_PLAN_TYPES redeclared locally instead of imported from lib/plans.js — import from shared source
Comment describes flat_discount_cents but code uses tiered formula — remove or fix misleading comment
Team renewal skips ai_hour_topups, relying implicitly on rollOverTeamPoolForUser — add explicit comment

PERSONAL_HOUR_BUDGETS has no 'lifetime' entry; plan_type='lifetime' subscribers fall through to the free budget (0 hours) and are paywalled by hourBudgetGate once topup hours run out — add lifetime budget entry
Admin grant-trial ON CONFLICT CASE omits 'lifetime'; granting a trial to a lifetime subscriber silently resets plan_type to 'free' — add 'lifetime' to both CASE branches

stripe.paymentIntents.create in chargeAndCredit has no automatic_tax field; when STRIPE_AUTOMATIC_TAX=1 is set auto-topup charges silently skip tax collection — add automatic_tax: { enabled: true } conditionally
validTypes array in handleCheckoutComplete unknown-price fallback omits 'lifetime'; metadata.type='lifetime' with an unrecognised price ID is silently activated as pro_monthly — add 'lifetime'

handleCheckoutComplete does not read session.subscription to store stripe_subscription_id; cancel-subscription endpoint returns 404 between checkout.session.completed and customer.subscription.updated — read session.subscription and store it

ALL_PLAN_TYPES includes 'admin' not present in packages/shared-db/src/plans.js; two copies are no longer equivalent — remove 'admin' or add it intentionally to the shared-db canonical file with a comment
Admin endpoints protected by adminGate but lack a dedicated stricter rate limiter — apply admin-specific rate limit
Math.random() for multipart boundary generation (non-security, acceptable)
Math.random() for quiz question shuffle (non-security, acceptable)
Empty catch on advisory lock release (intentional per inline comment)

/api/v1/ask route mounted with only authenticate + aiLimiter; hourBudgetGate and subscriptionRequired are absent; free users get unlimited Gemini/Claude calls via Ask Sona — add hourBudgetGate (and subscriptionRequired) to the mount
/cache/delete and /cache/flush async route handlers have no try/catch; unhandled rejection leaves response unsent — wrap in try/catch matching the pattern of adjacent handlers
generateOneSection fires fetch without AbortController; no useEffect cleanup aborts in-flight SSE requests on unmount — add AbortController ref with unmount cleanup
generateAiSolution calls fetch without AbortController; stream drains and setState fires on unmounted component after navigation — add AbortController ref with unmount cleanup
Five /api/admin/* mutation routes (grant admin, delete user, grant trial) use apiLimiter (60/min) same as public endpoints — add a stricter dedicated admin limiter
uid() fallback when crypto.randomUUID absent uses Math.random() for a session ID sent to proctor API — replace fallback with crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16))
resume hardcoded to '' with // TODO: get from user profile; AI prep always runs without resume, producing generic output — read from auth context or prompt user to paste
Root ErrorBoundary onError only console.error; production render panics are invisible without DevTools — wire a remote error sink (Sentry or lightweight fetch to /api/v1/client-error)
Missing SiteNav on public page — add SiteNav for brand consistency (feedback_nav_redirect_rules)
cyan-500 in gradient text — replace with emerald per Lumora palette rules (feedback_lumora_sharp_palette)
cyan-500 in gradient text (second occurrence) — replace with emerald per Lumora palette rules
text-cyan-200 in step labels — replace with emerald palette color
rgba(255,255,255,0.75) on variable backgrounds — verify WCAG contrast (feedback_no_white_on_white)
Hardcoded hex #10b981 for easy difficulty — replace with CSS design token
Hardcoded hex #f59e0b for medium difficulty — replace with CSS design token
Hardcoded hex #ef4444 for hard difficulty — replace with CSS design token
Hardcoded hex #ef4444 — consolidate with design token var(--danger)
Mixed CSS vars with hex fallbacks (#22c55e, #f59e0b, #ef4444) — standardize to single token system
Hardcoded hex #ef4444 for 'again' state — use design token
Hardcoded hex #f59e0b for 'hard' state — use design token
Hardcoded hex #22c55e for 'good' state — use design token
Hardcoded hex #3683DC (--accent value) — use CSS var(--accent) directly
Company brand colors hardcoded as hex values — move to shared constants
Hardcoded company brand colors — centralize in constants or design tokens
Hardcoded hex #3683DC and #2265BF in className — use CSS var(--accent)
Hardcoded 'Courier New',monospace in cssText override — replace with var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace) to respect the design system font
Hardcoded #00ea64 live-recording indicator — add --cam-status-live CSS token and reference it
